Shows Why The Public Does Not Trust The Medical Establishment –
And Why They Should Not! With Analysis by Richard Cowan

This letter is in response to yesterday’s posting.
See
Scientific American Magazine " Firmly Linked " to Reefer Madness

The author is a scientist who wishes to remain anonymous. Her own website shows a great concern with honesty and personal freedom.

I very much appreciate this contribution from an unusual perspective.)

Dear Richard,

Being a female, and a scientist, I've been forced to learn some ugly things about science.

For example, it is commonly touted by science folk that the brutal inhumane practice of witch hunting was halted by the advent of scientific reasoning that taught the villagers of Europe that witchcraft was just an ignorant superstition.

The truth is that many scientists of the witch hunting era actively promoted witch hunting for the furtherance of their own social agendas in science, and most of the others went along with the program without protest.
(MarijuanaNews note: The more things change, the more they stay the same. Except when they get worse…)

An example of the latter is astronomer Johannes Kepler, who spent several grueling years trying to rescue his mother from a witch hunt. She died of stress just a year after she was freed. But Kepler never attacked the idea of hunting witches when he defended his mother. The only argument he put forward as a defense was that his mother was not a witch.

A key example of an active scientist-witch hunter is Joseph Glanville, who served as an enthusiastic public proponent of the new scientific philosophy of mechanical determinism, and the chief publicist for the new professional scientific organization, the Royal Society, during the Newtonian era.

Glanville was an avid proponent of both the new experimental science and the old witch hunting. He wrote inflammatory pamphlets claiming that there remained at least 1000 certifiable witches in the villages of England who badly needed extermination.

Glanville also expressed great confidence that the new techniques of scientific reasoning and experiment would allow witch hunters to become more efficient at detecting and prosecuting their prey, so that Britain could finally win the war against witches.
See
From The Drug Czar’s 8-Year Plan to the Republican’s Drug-Free Century Act,
The Prohibitionist Agenda Is War Without End. Orwell Would Understand.
Analysis By Richard Cowan

The force that rose up and stopped Glanville in his tracks was not science, but religion. Protestant theology was shifting to a fashionable new idea -- a loving and all-powerful God, as opposed to the wrathful and Devil plagued God in whose name witches had been condemned to death for the last few centuries.

A loving and all-powerful God would never allow women to be seduced by Satan and turned into witches, the new theological reasoning went. And this reasoning proved powerful enough to stop Glanville and those on his side from fulfilling their evil designs.

It would be nice if cessation of the pot smoker hunts could come through scientific reasoning, but the situation now bears similarities to the situation during Glanville's time.

Glanville had a strong social reason to want to promote the unscientific idea that women were inherently vulnerable to being seduced by Satan and turned into witches. He was at the foundation of the construction of the professional scientific organization that served as one of the main barriers between women and the role of scientist in Britain. Glanville took the position that the scientific enterprise could not be conducted in the presence of women, neither as participants nor as mere observers, and the Royal Society remained a woman-free environment from Glanville's time until after W.W.II.

Now, two questions:

1. What proportion of the readers of Scientific American are black?

2. What proportion of Americans arrested for marijuana are black?
See
NORML Study Reveals Blacks Arrested For Marijuana At More Than Twice The Rate For Whites

Scientists are not going to come to the rescue here, because reefer madness serves to enforce and reinforce the very social and racial prejudice that keeps white males in charge of American science, just as fear of witches helped reinforce the conscious gender prejudice of scientists of Newton's age in Britain.

And nowadays, science is more expensive than ever before in history. Federal funding for scientific research is more important than ever before in determining the career possibilities of young American scientists.

Under those conditions, nobody in American science is very eager to take any stand that would put them at odds with the federal government.
(MarijuanaNews note: The National Institute on Drug Abuse, NIDA, provides 85% of the world’s funding for " research " on marijuana. They get mediocre science, but great press releases.)
See
Medical Marijuana and the Degradation of Science -- NIDA Funds More Than 85 Percent Of The World’s Research On Health Aspects Of " Drug Abuse " And Addiction and Suppresses Medical Marijuana.
and
As Predicted, NIDA Buys Its Press Release: " Marijuana has as much potential for abuse … as cocaine and heroin. "
and
New Media Merger: Washington Post Merges With NIDA.
and
How the Prohibitionist Funding Racket Really Works Shown As Califano Shills for DEA and NIDA.

One of the problems that compounds this disaster is that leftist academics in the underfunded humanities have been busy getting even with the research-rich fat cats in the science departments by promoting the idea that nothing at all can be resolved by appealing to the facts as determined by science.

Leaving poor pot smokers caught in the middle.

A Reader.

(MarijuanaNews note: Pot smokers are not the only victims of marijuana prohibition.)
